messages.content: That new Italian place on 5th Ave is amazing btw, you have to try it
haha yes exactly! ok I'll check it out this week
the pasta is homemade and the tiramisu is unreal
do you have a restaurant recommendation for a date night?
YES go to Osteria Romano, super cozy vibes and not too expensive
hey what are you doing this weekend?
I was thinking hiking on Saturday, maybe Riverside trail?
oh that sounds great, I'm down for that
Sunday we could also check out that market downtown, they have live music
perfect plans for the weekend honestly
did you watch the game last night?
yeah it was insane in the last 5 minutes
I almost had a heart attack lol
same 😭 thought we were done
btw I found a really good sushi place near the office
no way, what's it called?
Sakura Zen, they do an all-you-can-eat lunch for like $18
ok we're going there next week, I'll put it in the calendar
how's the new job going?
it's good! a lot to learn but the team seems really solid
that's awesome, I'm happy for you!
thanks 🙏 it was a big change but I think it was worth it
